subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should OpenClaw solve the remaining TUI work by documenting the current pi-tui bindings only, or by adding an OpenClaw-owned configurable send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: The dependency already provides default newline support, but exposing user-configurable Enter/Ctrl/Shift behavior would add a new public config or CLI contract under the repository's high config-surface bar.

options.title: Document Current Bindings First
options.body: Update docs and `/help` for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, backslash-Enter fallback, and terminal limitations without adding a new config surface yet.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Expose a documented TUI send/newline preference or keybinding bridge into pi-tui, with schema/help/docs and tests for defaults plus the opt-in mode.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Composer Direction
options.body: Handle TUI and WebChat shortcut preferences together after the WebChat settings-owner question is resolved.

recommendation.title: Document Current Bindings First
recommendation.body: Update docs and `/help` for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, backslash-Enter fallback, and terminal limitations without adding a new config surface yet.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current TUI docs/editor history and already provided the prior maintainer-routed review on this exact issue.
